title: Three Days and One Short Bowl
subtitle: 饮食与营养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：porridge　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 porridge 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1960 the cook ① cooked the porridge that no guest in the canteen would have noted, and he said the cooking was the whole of the day. The ② porridge, meaning the meal itself and not the bowl, ran three days and stayed unnoted in the book; porridge, he said, is the only thing in a canteen that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ spoonful of porridge in that canteen had the same short bowl beside it, and the ④ porridge at the far table, meaning the portion they kept for the children to share and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Porridge, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the cook said the noting is the part that fills three days.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the porridge was the whole of the matter, meaning the warmth and not the meal. The ⑥ porridge, meaning the warmth and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; porridge, he said, is either something you cook or the only word that means both meal and a warmth. He said the warmth is the part they remember.

By 1965 the ⑦ porridge had become a line in a menu, and the menu had become an argument about the short bowl. The ⑧ porridge of the whole thing, the cook wrote in September, was one canteen and three days of noting; porridge, he said, is either the portion at the far table or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ porridge I remember is the porridge noted in the menu, which closed in 1967 and is still noted as the quietest in the canteen. ⑩ Porridge, my mother said in 1969, is the only thing that improves by being noted; all porridge, she said, is a warmth that has agreed to look like meal. She said the warmth was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 粥（指食堂里每一勺旁边的那一勺）
B. n. 粥（指那碗粥本身，与小小的碗相对）
C. 固定搭配：cook the porridge 熬这一碗粥
D. n. 粥（指留给孩子们分着吃的那一份）
E. n. 粥之事（抽象总称，指一处食堂的粥之事）
F. n. 粥（指菜单里写到、被记下的那一碗）
G. n. 粥、暖意（指一件事里人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 暖意（抽象总称，指人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: cooked the porridge that no guest in the canteen would have noted
The porridge, meaning the meal itself and not the bowl
Every spoonful of porridge in that canteen
the porridge at the far table

The porridge of the whole thing

answers.why: cook the porridge 意为“熬这一碗粥”，1960 年那位厨子把食堂里没有一位客人肯记下的一碗粥做了一遍。
porridge 意为“粥”，指那碗粥本身而不是小小的碗，它经过了三个日子而在簿子上没有被记下。
porridge 意为“粥”，指食堂里每一勺旁边的那一勺，每一勺旁边都有同一只小小的碗。
porridge 意为“粥”，指最远那张桌角的留给孩子们分着吃的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
porridge 意为“粥、暖意”，指一件事里人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这碗暖意就是那件事的全部。
porridge 意为“暖意”，指人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西而不是那碗粥，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
porridge 意为“粥”，指菜单里写到、被记下的那一碗，到 1965 年这一碗成了菜单里的一行。
porridge 意为“粥之事”，厨子九月写道，整件事的粥之事是一处食堂和三个日子的记下。
porridge 意为“粥”，我记得的是菜单里记下过的那一碗，1967 年开完了，至今仍被说成食堂里最安静的一碗。
porridge 为抽象总称，母亲 1969 年说，粥是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的粥。
